title: Value Orb
tagline: Value Orbs: A next-gen social wallet leveraging NFT technology to visualize and align personal values, enhancing social connectivity and community engagement.
description: Value Orbs redefines social networking by introducing a platform where users can represent their core values as NFTs, fostering a deeper level of connection and compatibility within communities. Users earn these NFTs through quizzes, community interactions, and partner actions, creating a unique social fabric that empowers genuine relationships and value-driven communities. This innovative approach not only enhances social engagement but also introduces a new paradigm in personal and community development.
how_its_made: The "Value Orbs" project is a pioneering platform that intersects the realms of social networking and blockchain, using Ethereum smart contracts for the minting, trading, and management of NFTs that represent users' values. Unlike typical NFT platforms, Value Orbs focuses on the intrinsic, non-monetary value these tokens represent, making social interactions more meaningful.
